_finding: A transaction is signed by hand here, from keccak and secp256k1. A wrong byte does not fail loudly: it spends gas and leaves either nothing or something we did not mean, and nobody notices for days. The test rebuilds a real transaction taken off Base mainnet, so every one of these mutations has to break it.

mutations.name: the typed-transaction envelope is dropped
mutations.expect: FAIL and our payload recovers the sender the node reports

mutations.name: zero is encoded as a zero byte instead of nothing
mutations.expect: FAIL zero is no bytes at all, which rlp writes as 0x80

mutations.name: rlp switches to its long form one byte late
mutations.expect: FAIL 56 bytes switches to the long form

mutations.name: the address is taken from the whole public key, prefix byte included
mutations.expect: FAIL and our payload recovers the sender the node reports
